messages:
emily: Quick update: were launching the Unified Streaming Gateway to GA this morning. This consolidates streaming calls + tool-calling into one endpoint and introduces the new low-memory model 'mosaic-lite-v1' optimized for <2s cold-starts. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/unified-streaming-gateway 

natalie: Congrats! Will this change any request shapes?

emily: Minimal change. Main difference: single POST /v1/gateway/stream with a small JSON envelope. Existing streaming clients will keep working for 2 weeks while we offer an opt-in toggle in Console. Migration guide is on the docs page.

kevin: Note for SDKs: streaming client default will remain until we flip migration. We'll publish SDK patches today. If you need early access to canary keys or higher QPS, DM me.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout status: unified-gateway service deployed to eu-west-1, us-west-2, us-east-1. Canary at 20% -> currently 60%. No errors reported.

david: Any runtime caveats? memory/quantization?

emily: mosaic-lite-v1 is 4-bit quantized, fits in 16GB GPU with room for batching. It trades some perplexity vs mosaic-pro; we added an automatic degrade route to mosaic-pro when quality thresholds fail. Also added a KV-prefix cache opt-in to reduce token costs.

natalie: What about billing?

emily: Usage counts same token model billing. Were adding an interpretability column in Console showing per-route cost delta when you switch to the gateway.

kevin: Operational note: logs and traces are on the new gateway service path: https://internal-logs/gateway/1841276543. Alerting updated to notify "gateway-latency" with a 95p threshold.

david: Can someone paste an example curl?

emily: Sure:
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/gateway/stream \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite-v1","stream":true,"tools":true,"input":"summarize: ..."}'
```

natalie: I clicked the docs link and the migration section is a bit light on rollback steps. Can we add a quick rollback checklist?

emily: Good catch  Ill add a rollback checklist + a runbook snippet in the docs in the next 30m.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Minor incident detected during canary at 2026-04-02T09:12Z: transient 503s for a subset of requests. Auto-retry handled most client calls. Root cause: connection pool exhaustion in one replica; mitigated by adding backpressure and increasing pool size. No customer impact reported.

kevin: I'll coordinate with support to surface a short FAQ for customers who DM about the new endpoint.

emily: TL;DR: Unified Streaming Gateway GA is live, mosaic-lite-v1 available, 2-week opt-in window for existing orgs, canary keys from kevin, rollback/runbook update incoming. Thanks team! :tada:
